senses.gloss: (b. h.) to move on, run.—[Part. pass., v. רָגוּל.]

units: <cite ref="Niddah 16b:53">Nidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שרֹ הנִרְגָּל וכ׳</he> a magistrate (a scholar) who is an habitual visitor of drinking houses; v. <cite ref="T00173"><he>רָגַז</he></cite> a. <cite ref="T00215"><he>רָגַן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of רֶגֶל) to flay an animal from its feet upward (in order to use the skin as a bag, v. חֵמֶת).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:3">Ḥull. IX, 3</cite> <he>המַרְגִּיל וכ׳</he> if one flays from the feet upward, the entire skin is considered as connected (with the flesh, as long as the process lasts) for purposes of levitical cleanness.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:11">Tosef. Bets. II, 11</cite> <he>אין מַרְגִּילִין וכ׳</he> we must not flay from the feet on a Holy Day, nor on a week day when the animal is a firstborn &c.; <cite ref="Bekhorot 33a">Bekh. 33ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 24a:2">Tem. 24ᵃ</cite>
<cite ref="Shabbat 13a:2">Sabb. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא יַרְגִּילֶנּוּ אצלו</he> lest he make him accustomed to associate with him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 13a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>וכי מַרְגִּילוֹ וכ׳</he> and if he does accustom him, what of it? <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:13">Ab. III, 13</cite> <he>שחוק … מַרְגִּילִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01300"><he>קַלּוּת</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:3">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ותַרְגִּילֵנִי לידי מצוה ואל תרגילני וכ׳</he> and lead me into the power (to the opportunity) of good deeds, and lead me not into the power of sin.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>שתרגילני בתורתך</he> that thou mayest lead me by thy Law.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 85b">Yeb. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>זהו מַרְגִּילוֹ וזוהי מַרְגִּילָתוֹ</he> in the one case he leads (persuades) her to marry him, in the other case she persuades him; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>המרגיל</he> (sub. <cite ref="S02017"><he>קרי</he></cite>) who causes an effusion of semen, opp. <he>לאונסו</he>.

senses.gloss: to accustom one’s self, get used to. Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ top שהוא מִתְרַגֵּל עמו וכ׳ when he gets used to associate with him when he is unclean himself, he is likely to associate with him when he is clean. Y. Ned. XI, end, 42ᵈ יעשו סעודה והן מִתְרַגְּלִין לַבָּא וכ׳ (some ed. לבוא) let a banquet be arranged, and they (the disaffected couple) will get used in future to associate with each other through the influence of the banquet.
